defects.description: After the cache has data, each uncached key receives a separate lookup rather than one batched operation.

trigger.input: Inject a counted lookup, load alpha, then request alpha, beta and gamma together.
trigger.expected: Two total lookup calls: alpha, then beta/gamma.

defects.why_missed: The suite uses only the default lookup with no call-counting dependency and no mixed cached/uncached request.

defects.description: Cleanup bounds only newly appended failures, retaining all previous entries indefinitely.

trigger.input: Inject an unsuccessful release and persistent log at limit=2; collect alpha/beta, then gamma.

defects.why_missed: The suite has no failed-release adapter or persistent log, and performs one successful collection.
